body.message:
Hi! I’m interested in renting an apartment starting from May 15th and I’m looking for a monthly rental.

Could you please confirm:
- The total monthly price and any additional fees (agency, utilities, deposit, etc.)
- The minimum and maximum rental duration (how long the apartment can be rented)
- What is included in the rent (furnished, bills, internet, etc.)

Also, could you let me know the availability and if viewings (in person or virtual) are possible?

Thank you in advance!
